{C:81900400}{C:81958296FD2F00000000}The situation is unknown.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296FE2F00000000}Can you tell us anything, Rondo?

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296073000000000}Welcome aboard the Astante II.
I'm Captain Rie Akatsuki.

{C:81902000}{C:81958296093000000000}Thank you for rescuing me.
I am Ciela Lapana.

{C:819582960A3000000000}Todd Guinness of the Kingdom of A pursued me,
and I wandered into this space.

{C:81900700}{C:819582960B3000000000}Do you know
how to get out of here?

{C:81902000}{C:819582960C3000000000}Would you take me to the {C:819782830300}Kingdom of Na{C:819782830000}?
Please?

{C:81930100}{C:819582960D3000000000}That much is easy.
Just tell us where to go.


{C:81932000}{C:819582960E3000000000}I'll assist you with my aura power.
Proceed freely through the Cloud Sea.



{x00}

{C:81932000}{C:81958296103000000000}Now then,

{C:81930300}{C:81958296123000000000}Y-yes!
I'm sorry...



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81902000}{C:81958296133000000000}Thank you for your trouble.
In return, let me tell you something useful.

{C:81958296143000000000}I hear Nie Given is in the {C:819782830300}Kingdom of Lau{C:819782830000},
waiting for you.
Do go and see him.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296153000000000}The Kingdom of Lau?
Understood. We'll go there.

{C:81902000}{C:81958296173000000000}And once you've joined up with Nie Given,
come back to the Kingdom of Na.
I have something good to give you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296183000000000}Something good...?

{C:81902000}{C:819582961A3000000000}Now, be on your way.
The Kingdom of Lau must be in dire straits.
Go prepared for what awaits you.

{C:81930100}{C:819582961B3000000000}Thank you.




{x00}

{C:81901E00}{C:819582961E3000000000}I've been waiting for you to return.

{C:81901D00}{C:819582961F3000000000}Welcome back! Have you been well?

{C:81901A00}{C:819582962D0100000000}I heard things were bad in the Kingdom of Lau,
so I'm relieved you're safe.

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296203000000000}Lady Elle will tell you about that herself. Let's go to 
{C:819782830300}Chiron Castle{C:819782830000}.

{C:81901C00}{C:81958296213000000000}Chiron Castle? Then King Foizon
has accepted Lady Elle.



{x00}

{C:81930A02}{C:81958296223000000000}Those are good terms.
I'll lend a hand, too.

{C:81936500}{C:81958296243000000000}Things on my continent
are beyond hope now,
so I'm grateful for your help.

{C:81930A02}{C:81958296263000000000}I'm a target myself, you know.
It's reassuring to have
someone willing to cooperate.

{C:81936500}{C:81958296273000000000}All riiight, let's
corner the Astante II!




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81902400}{C:81958296293000000000}I'm so glad you've returned.
I'm happy you're safe.
You all look much more confident now.

{C:819582962B3000000000}Sho Zama, I sense aura power in you
truly worthy of a Holy Warrior.

{C:81901A00}{C:819582962E0100000000}Thank you.
So, what's
the current situation?

{C:81902400}{C:819582962C3000000000}King Foizon died in battle,
and I succeeded him to the throne.

{C:819582962D3000000000}The Kingdoms of A and Na
are building large Aura Ships.

{C:81930100}{C:819582962E3000000000}Large Aura Ships?
Come to think of it,
this place looks like a ship's bridge, too.

{C:81902400}{C:819582962F3000000000}That's right.
This is the bridge of Lau's large Aura Ship, the 
{C:819782830400}Goraon{C:819782830000}.

{C:81958296303000000000}With these larger ships,
the devastation of war will spread as well.
Please lend us your strength again.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296313000000000}Gladly.
What should we
do first?

{C:81902400}{C:81958296323000000000}Ultimately, I believe we'll need
to destroy the large Aura Ships.

{C:81958296333000000000}Until then, defeat the enemies
throughout the region.
Nie, I ask you and your companions to help, too.

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296343000000000}Of course!

{C:81902400}{C:81958296353000000000}Then I'm counting on you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296363000000000}Yes.





{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81901C00}{C:81958296373000000000}To think King Foizon has died...

{C:81901D00}{C:81958296383000000000}King Foizon was brave.
He was always at the front,
leading the fight.

{C:81901E00}{C:819582963A3000000000}We won't get anywhere
by standing around mourning.

{C:819582963C3000000000}While you were away from Byston Well,
we found some allies.
Could you take them aboard the Astante II?

{C:81930100}{C:819582963D3000000000}It's reassuring
to have allies everywhere.

{C:81901E00}{C:819582963E3000000000}Let me introduce the three of them: 
{C:819782830400}Jiron{C:819782830000}, {C:819782830400}Rag{C:819782830000}, and {C:819782830400}Elchi{C:819782830000}.

{C:8190FD01}{C:819582963F3000000000}Great to meet you!!






{x00}

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296403000000000}Have you decided
where you're heading?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296413000000000}Someone named Ciela in the Kingdom of Na
asked us to come,
so I think we'll go there first.

{C:81901D00}{C:81958296423000000000}Lady Ciela did!?
That's incredible!

{C:81900200}{C:81958296443000000000}I thought she seemed noble,
but is she really that important?

{C:81901D00}{C:81958296453000000000}Important doesn't begin to cover it! Right, Nie?

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296473000000000}Lady Ciela is
the name of the Queen of Na.
If it's true, this is quite something.

{C:81901A00}{C:819582962F0100000000}She acted important,
but she really was important, huh?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296483000000000}I'm starting to dread going.
I had no idea she was so important.

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296300100000000}What are you talking about?
We've got a prince with us, too.

{C:81900200}{C:819582964A3000000000}We haven't done anything wrong.
Let's hold our heads high.

{C:81930100}{C:819582964B3000000000}Thanks, Lun.
I feel a little better now.




{x00}

{C:8193E901}{C:819582964C3000000000}{C:819782830400}Noin{C:819782830000},
you don't have to come with me.

{C:8193EB01}{C:81958296310100000000}Please don't make me say it twice.
I told you
I wouldn't leave your side.

{C:8193E901}{C:819582964D3000000000}Very well.
Then we'll join the Astante II.
Our guests behind us are getting noisy, too.

{C:8193EB01}{C:81958296320100000000}Yes, Zechs.




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900700}{C:819582964F3000000000}Ah, you came at just the right time.
I've finished a new FT.
Choose a pilot for it.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296503000000000}That's amazing, Professor.
FT development has been
going smoothly lately!

{C:81900700}{C:81958296513000000000}Seeing machines from other continents
is a good source of inspiration.

{C:81958296523000000000}Anyway,
look at the machine and choose
a pilot who seems capable of flying it.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296533000000000}Then I'll check it later.

{C:81900700}{C:81958296543000000000}I'm counting on you.






{x00}

{C:81902000}{C:81958296563000000000}You've come as you promised.

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296573000000000}Lady Ciela, isn't it dangerous
for you to come all the way out here?

{C:81902000}{C:81958296583000000000}It's all right, Nie Given.
This is all
I can do.

{C:81958296593000000000}I'll entrust Sho Zama with an Aura Battler
developed in the Kingdom of Na.
The Aura Battler {C:819782830400}Billbine{C:819782830000}.

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296330100000000}Billbine?

{C:81902000}{C:819582965A3000000000}I've already given orders
to take it aboard the Astante II.
Go and see it for yourself.


{x00}

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296340100000000}Sorry,
I'm heading back to the Astante II
to take a look!

{C:81930100}{C:819582965B3000000000}Thank you,
Queen Ciela Lapana.

{C:81902000}{C:819582965C3000000000}Now that you've returned,
both Drake and Bishot
will attack you in earnest.

{C:819582965D3000000000}I, too, will begin operations
aboard the Gran-Garan.
Do your best, all of you.

{C:81930100}{C:819582965E3000000000}Yes, Lady Ciela.
Let's go, Nie!

{C:81901E00}{C:819582965F3000000000}Let's go!!



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:8190C800}{C:81958296623000000000}So, what are we going to do?

{C:81900600}{C:81958296633000000000}Which countries
are our enemies on this continent?

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296643000000000}Allow me to answer that.
The Kingdoms of A and Ku.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296663000000000}If we know where they are,
we should head for those countries.

{C:81958296673000000000}They'll probably send out their forces, too.
We'll stop them before they get going.

{C:81900A00}{C:81958296683000000000}Heh, that Kyo...
He's really getting back into his stride.

{C:81900900}{C:81958296350100000000}For a moment, I could see
the old Kyo in him.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296693000000000}If you have objections, speak up now.
But give me an alternative, too.

{C:81908400}{C:819582966A3000000000}I have no particular objections.

{C:81905401}{C:819582966C3000000000}I'm fine with it, too.

{C:81930100}{C:819582966D3000000000}It looks like nobody objects,
so let's go with Dad's plan.



{x00}

{C:81932B00}{C:81958296370100000000}I'm sorry my power wasn't enough.

{C:81933100}{C:819582966F3000000000}There's no need to worry.
The fighting will continue for a long time yet.



{x00}

{C:81932900}{C:81958296703000000000}So you've returned, Astante II.
I'll teach you a lesson!

{C:81932700}{C:81958296713000000000}Hold on there, {C:819782830400}Black Knight{C:819782830000}.
Don't forget you're fighting alongside
Todd Guinness here.

{C:81932900}{C:81958296723000000000}I know.
As long as I can sink the Astante II,
that's all I need.

{C:81932700}{C:81958296733000000000}As long as you understand that, fine.
Let's sink them!


{x00}

{C:81932400}{C:81958296753000000000}Can you hear me, Astante II?
I hear the Kingdom of Ku's large Aura Ship
has begun operations.

{C:81958296763000000000}Please head for the {C:819782830300}Kingdom of Ku{C:819782830000} at once.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296783000000000}Understood.
We're heading for the Kingdom of Ku.



{x00}

{C:81933800}{C:819582967A3000000000}What a strange thing to say.
You want me to build a large Aura Ship, too?

{C:81930C00}{C:819582967B3000000000}That's right...

{C:81933800}{C:819582967C3000000000}Wouldn't that make me appear
to have intentions of rebelling
against His Excellency Drake?

{C:81930C00}{C:819582967E3000000000}Use that gift of gab of yours
to explain it away however you like.

{C:81933800}{C:819582967F3000000000}Well, I'll consider it.


{x00}

{C:81933800}{C:81958296803000000000}It seems I was right to listen
to that insolent brat back then.

{C:81958296813000000000}Soldiers!
Annihilate the enemy with all your strength!!


{x00}

{C:81930700}{C:81958296823000000000}More enemies!?

{C:8193EC01}{C:81958296833000000000}I am Treize Khushrenada.
I've come to join your ship.

{C:81958296843000000000}My envoy, Lady Une,
should be with you.

{C:8193ED01}{C:81958296863000000000}I'm here, Your Excellency.

{C:8193EC01}{C:81958296853000000000}Well done, Lady.
We'd like to join you, too.
Would you speak to them for us?

{C:81930300}{C:81958296873000000000}If you know them,
I don't mind.

{C:81930600}{C:81958296883000000000}It's dangerous to trust people so easily.
First we need to investigate more thoroughly...

{C:81930300}{C:819582968A3000000000}Dad, keep quiet!
This is how we've done things all along!

{C:81930600}{C:819582968B3000000000}But...

{C:81930400}{C:819582968C3000000000}It's no use, Uncle Akatsuki.
We've always done things this way,
and I don't think that's going to change.

{C:81930100}{C:819582968D3000000000}That's right.
Just give it up, Dad.
Nelfea!

{C:81930400}{C:819582968E3000000000}Yes, yes. I'll get ready to receive them.



{x00}

{C:8193EC01}{C:819582968F3000000000}Thank you for allowing us to join you.
I'm grateful for the captain's bold decision.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296913000000000}No, thank you.
We're glad you've joined us.

{C:81935A02}{C:81958296923000000000}I wanted to join you a little sooner,
but I was investigating the enemy's affairs.
My apologies.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296933000000000}Not at all.
We're just glad you've joined us.

{C:81935402}{C:81958296943000000000}Brother!


{x00}

{C:81905A02}{C:81958296963000000000}I didn't know where you'd gone.
So you were aboard this ship!

{C:81905402}{C:81958296973000000000}Yes, they let me aboard
in Pentagona.

{C:81905A02}{C:81958296983000000000}Now I can fight with peace of mind.


{x00}

{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900700}{C:819582969A3000000000}Since you were on the enemy's side,
do you also know where
the mastermind behind this war is?

{C:8190EC01}{C:819582969B3000000000}Of course.
The ringleader's name is...

{C:81900600}{C:819582969C3000000000}Redros Binzvanker.

{C:8190E901}{C:819582969D3000000000}How do you know that!?

{C:81900700}{C:819582969E3000000000}I'm ashamed to say
Binzvanker comes from our continent.
That's why we're pursuing them.

{x00}

{C:81933200}{C:81958296390100000000}There is no path forward for you!

{C:81901E00}{C:81958296A03000000000}That voice is Drake Luft's!!

{C:81930400}{C:81958296A13000000000}A large Aura Ship is approaching!
Battle stations!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A23000000000}I'm sorry to ask when you've only just arrived,
but please help us right away!



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81933200}{C:819582963A0100000000}What rules the world is ability, power!
In turmoil, parent, child and sibling mean nothing.

{C:819582963B0100000000}If the low overthrowing the high is the way of the world,
then the powerful must destroy
those who deserve it and bring peace to the world.

{C:819582963C0100000000}Ignorant rabble like you could never
understand my lofty ideals!
That's why destruction is the fate you deserve!!

{C:81930600}{C:81958296A33000000000}Don't give us that self-serving nonsense!
You're just a man riding
Binzvanker's coattails!!

{C:81933200}{C:819582963D0100000000}Impudent fool!
Whether I'm merely riding someone's coattails
is something you can find out firsthand!!



{x00}

{C:81933100}{C:81958296A43000000000}Things are proceeding
just as you predicted.

{C:81958296A53000000000}As promised, I'll now transmit
the Astante II's combat data
and information on the large Aura Ships.

{C:81958296A63000000000}(Now, let's see how you'll respond,
 Binzvanker.)




{x00}

{C:81932201}{C:81958296A73000000000}Le Caine!?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A83000000000}Who is that?

{C:81932201}{C:81958296A93000000000}He's the son of Gresco,
Grados's supreme commander.

{C:81930400}{C:81958296AA3000000000}It looks like something is pursuing him.


{x00}

{C:81936500}{C:81958296AB3000000000}You did well to escape from Gon Jem and me.
I'm impressed.
But this is the end!!

{C:81932B01}{C:81958296AC3000000000}Ngh, in a place like this...!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AD3000000000}Let's help him!

{C:81932201}{C:81958296AF3000000000}He's the enemy commander's son!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B03000000000}We'll think about that after we help him.
Rie, engage the enemy!!


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81902201}{C:81958296B33000000000}Saving an enemy...
That's just like you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B43000000000}Sorry...

{C:81902201}{C:81958296B53000000000}You don't need to apologize.
I'm genuinely impressed
that you'd reach out to an enemy.

{C:81902B01}{C:81958296B63000000000}Who's in command of this ship!?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296B73000000000}I'm the captain.

{C:81902B01}{C:81958296B83000000000}I am Le Caine of Grados.
I am requisitioning this ship.

{C:81908400}{C:81958296B93000000000}We can't allow that.
We have our own objectives.

{C:81902F01}{C:81958296BA3000000000}Shall we kill them, Lord Le Caine?

{C:81902201}{C:81958296BC3000000000}You're going to kill the people who saved you!?
Are Gradosians
really such an inferior race!?

{C:81902C01}{C:81958296BD3000000000}You're Eiji!
What a perfect place to meet you!
I'll fucking kill you right now!

{C:81902B01}{C:81958296BE3000000000}Stop, Death Demon Squad!
Our priority now is to eliminate
the one who has taken control of Grados.

{C:81902E01}{C:819582963F0100000000}You can't mean... Lord Le Caine?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C03000000000}Will you lend us your strength?

{C:81902B01}{C:81958296C13000000000}For now,
our interests coincide.
I'll cooperate only as long as they do.



{x00}

{C:81902B01}{C:81958296C23000000000}Understand!?
Only for as long
as our interests coincide!

{C:81900600}{C:81958296C33000000000}Has the commotion died down?
We're leaving immediately.

{C:81900A00}{C:81958296C63000000000}{C:819782830300}Grados{C:819782830000} can now be reached through the opening in the Cloud Sea.
At last, it's time for the final battle!

{C:81900600}{C:81958296C53000000000}Organize our forces
so we're ready for battle at any time.





{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81932000}{C:81958296C73000000000}In the end,
we left you to shoulder all the hardship alone.
I'm sorry.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C83000000000}We've been fighting all this time.
Please don't worry about it.

{C:81932400}{C:81958296C93000000000}But if we'd arrived in time,
your battle should have been a little easier.
When I think of that...

{C:81930600}{C:81958296CA3000000000}The Cloud Sea has opened, too.
We're heading for Grados.
We'll leave the rest to you.

{C:81932000}{C:81958296CB3000000000}Understood.
We'll concentrate our efforts
on pacifying Byston Well.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296CC3000000000}Thank you. We're counting on you.
Rie, take us out.

{C:81930300}{C:81958296CD3000000000}Yes! Astante II is
launching for Grados!


{x00}

{C:81932000}{C:81958296CF3000000000}They've gone.
Are you sure it was all right
not to tell them you were here?

{C:81936101}{C:81958296D03000000000}It's all right.
They have a hard road ahead,
but I'll devote myself to supporting the heroes.

{C:81932000}{C:81958296D13000000000}I was surprised, though.
Who would have thought someone with responsibilities in {C:819782830300}Brave{C:819782830000}
had stowed away aboard the Astante II?

{C:81936101}{C:81958296D23000000000}My old blood started stirring.
I couldn't help coming aboard.
It's embarrassing at my age.

{C:81932000}{C:81958296D33000000000}Since you're here,
please make yourself comfortable and relax.

{C:81936101}{C:81958296D43000000000}Thank you.
I'll gladly accept your hospitality,
Queen Ciela Lapana.
